comment: Particle recipes (Phase B, B0.7): presentation data, not game content. Each is one GPUParticles3D built by ParticleRecipes.cs -
a burst (all at once, once) or a stream - of camera-facing quads showing a texture (a flipbook when grid is given, played at fps),
coloured along a ramp over each particle's life and scaled along size_curve. Distances in metres, speeds in metres a second.
Textures are asset-workspace paths; every one carries its provenance record beside it (vfx/<id>.json).
An effect may also name a formula form, form:<name> (Art/FormulaForms.cs): geometry drawn by its own shader - the ward's lattice, the
mending's threads, the cast glyph, the bolt's core and its pressure front. formulas: each formula's ink and its glyph's polygon.

effects.comment: What the game draws with recipes (--visual vfx=recipes): a flipbook effect's ID, or a greybox moment's key, to the recipes that stand in for it.

formulas.comment: The cast glyph per formula (Phase B VFX lane): its ink, and the polygon turning inside it - Force three sides, Warding four, Vital six.

force_bolt_trail.note: Impulse Bolt in flight: cold displaced air, never a flame colour (magic_vfx.json). Unity Labs FireBall01 (CC0) through a cold ramp.

force_bolt_burst.note: Impulse Bolt where it stops: a pressure puff, the same cold flipbook thrown outward once.

force_bolt_shards.note: Impulse Bolt where it strikes (VFX lane): a dozen hard cold points thrown outward and stopped short by the air - the blow's crack, not a fire.

impact_sparks.note: Steel on stone or bone. Ported from the Godot VFX Library's sparks (MIT): 30 at once, half a second, all directions, gravity, white to orange.

torch_flame.note: A torch or a brazier. Unity Labs Flame02 (CC0), rising slowly, a few at a time.

chimney_smoke.note: Smoke from a chimney or a hearth: Unity Labs WispySmoke01 (CC0), lit, rising and leaning downwind, swelling as it thins.

ash_motes.note: Ash hanging in the Charwood's air: grey flakes drifting down and across round the camera, lit.

pollen.note: Pollen and dust in the meadow's sunlight: tiny warm specks drifting round the camera.

rain.note: Rain in a storm: thin streaks in a box over the camera, falling fast and a little downwind, standing upright.

river_mist.note: Mist over the ravine river: Unity Labs Cloud01 (CC0) as broad, slow, faint sheets along the water.

embers.note: Embers over a fire or the forge: the spark texture, rising and drifting, long-lived. The VFX Library's fireball_trail recipe, lengthened.

mending_threads.note: Mending Thread on the body (remediation): pale green-white threads rising round the body and circling it, each fading in and out, so nothing is cut off at a frame edge (the 128 px flipbook's threads ran into its cell edges). Project-owned strand (tools/asset_pipeline/_gen_vfx_strand.py).

mending_motes.note: Mending Thread's motes: small warm points rising and circling round the chest where the threads stitch (VFX lane: warmer, fewer).
